nodes.prompt: Photorealistic vertical 9:16 photo, the first frame of a video shot, looking like an ordinary frame from a real camera with a normal lens, not a render; true-to-life gentle colors and soft natural contrast; fine natural grain; the far background a touch softer than the foreground. No over-sharpening, no HDR, no CGI look. Image 1 is the empty birthday dining room: the shot takes place in exactly this room, same furniture, same light; keep the background exactly as in Image 1. Image 2 is her son's character sheet: use it only for his face, skin tone, haircut, beard and clothes. Image 3 is the granddaughter's character sheet: use it only for her face, skin tone, braids, earrings and clothes. Image 4 shows this birthday dinner from the main camera, with everyone in their seats: use it only to know who sits where, how the aunt and the uncle look and dress, and where things stand on the table and the sideboard. Medium shot. The photo shows a medium shot from across the birthday table: the son stands at his chair raising his drinking glass toward his mother at the head of the table, just out of the frame; behind him, soft, the wall with the archway; the sideboard is out of the frame, on the side he looks toward; beside him, soft, his daughter, still chewing, her fork in her hand; beyond her the aunt lifts her drinking glass toward the head of the table. Her son: a 46-year-old Black American man with deep brown skin, a low taper fade with a little grey at the temples, a neatly trimmed salt-and-pepper beard, a tense jaw and a gold wedding band. He wears a navy quarter-zip pullover and chinos. The granddaughter: a 19-year-old Black American woman with medium brown skin, long knotless braids gathered in a low ponytail, small gold hoop earrings and a bright, expressive face. She wears a plain grey hoodie with no logo and leggings. The aunt, the grandmother's younger sister, about 66: a Black American woman with medium-brown skin, a round face and shoulder-length silver-grey natural hair in soft twists; she wears a plum-colored dress. This shot shows only part of the dinner: everyone not described here is out of the frame, and nobody else is in the room. Other dishes on the table, soft: collard greens, candied sweet potatoes and cornbread. No birthday cake on the table yet. The granddaughter's own water bottle stands on the table just beyond her plate, on the side away from her father, clear of her hands, and nobody touches it: a large light-pink insulated tumbler with a handle, a lid and a straw, plain, with no logo or lettering. Expressions true to this moment: the son proud and warm, smiling at his mother as he toasts; his daughter chewing with a strained, uneasy face, trying not to show it; the aunt smiling, her glass raised; natural and believable, never exaggerated or posed. Every hand has five fingers in natural proportion and a natural grip; each person has exactly two arms and two hands; nothing floats. Everyone's eyes stay off-lens; nobody looks into the camera. Look: warm evening light from a small chandelier, soft shadows, warm family-film color. Skin as a real camera sees it from a couple of meters away: natural, with subtle texture and slight unevenness, not retouched, not over-detailed; no airbrushed, waxy or plastic skin. Brown skin true to life: each person keeps their own skin depth and undertone, with soft natural highlights and visible detail in the shadows; palms lighter than the backs of the hands; never grey, ashy or lightened. Final check: her son is the same man as in his character sheet, with the same skin tone, haircut and beard; the granddaughter is the same young woman as in her character sheet, with the same skin tone and braids. No subtitles, no captions, no text overlays; the banner lettering in the background stays.
